code_hints: If landing on the locale homepage (/en-de/ with no category), immediately rewrite to the primary PLP seed via url_rules.normalize before DOM actions.

Try clicking consent in this order and continue regardless of failures: #onetrust-accept-btn-handler, button[aria-label*="Accept"], button:has-text("Accept All"). Then close/continue geo/store overlay with button:has-text("Continue") or [data-testid*="continue"].
Consider main a[href*="/p/"] as PLP product tiles. Filter duplicates by href and keep only same-host links.
Only treat links containing "/p/" as PDP. Ignore editorial tiles.

On PDP, first parse JSON-LD (script[type="application/ld+json"]) and prefer offers.price if present. Fallback to selectors: meta[itemprop=price]@content, meta[property=product:price:amount]@content, span[itemprop=price].
Support selector suffix @attr (e.g., @content) to extract attributes when provided; if not supported, treat as CSS selector then read the specified attribute.
Set Accept-Language header to en-DE to reduce locale redirects; also rewrite any navigated URLs to enforce /en-de/ prefix.

Wait for at least one PLP tile selector (main a[href*="/p/"]) before extraction; if not present after consent handling, trigger normalize rewrite to the alternate seed (women/outerwear/down-jackets/).
rationale: The failure occurred because we landed on the Moncler homepage, which has no PLP grid and may show consent/geo overlays. We enforce a stable PLP seed under /en-de/ and add robust product tile detection via anchors linking to /p/ (Moncler PDP pattern). We add cookie/geo consent clicks and a locale-forcing rule to avoid language/country traps or monclergroup.com. PDP price/title extraction is hardened with meta and JSON-LD fallbacks, reducing dependency on volatile classes.
